classification: internal paired diagnostic; not a DeepfakeBench leaderboard result

algorithm: measure original-camera and generated high-pass energy only inside pixels changed by face fusion
scale only the generated face's own residual after final camera-resolution paste
bound relative energy to 0.8-1.7x camera energy and absolute amplification to 2.5x
apply a generated-only 0.15 fine-scale term at the qualified 3.5 setting
feather both operations through the changed-pixel mask; no original RGB texture is copied

interpretation: The requested threshold is met on the pooled 160-pair corpus and on two of three short windows.
The independent final window missed Meso4, so this is not evidence that every pose or lighting window will remain below 0.5.
AUC below 0.5 means the detector ranking is reversed, not that detection is impossible; an evaluator can invert its score. Distance from 0.5 remains the more meaningful separability diagnostic.

The large short-window Meso4 range (0.0592 to 0.5806) demonstrates pose and small-sample sensitivity. No fixed contrast manipulation was deployed because it improved one window while regressing another.
No detector gradients, adversarial perturbations, target-score feedback, or original-face texture transfer are used in the deployed pipeline.

identity_preservation.interpretation: mean source identity is unchanged within 0.0002 cosine
